name: kensa-qa
description: ISTQB CTFL v4.0.1-grounded manual QA team for the Kensa TMS — Codex edition. The base ships kensa + core testing skills plus browser / device / API / automation-result tooling, schema adaptation, and Blueprints automation, with a cross-platform Stop hook for auto memory checkpoints; optional bundles layer on top. Test Lead + QA Engineer + Schema-bootstrap install as project-scoped Codex subagents (.codex/agents/*.toml).

interface.shortDescription: ISTQB-grounded manual QA team in your pocket
interface.longDescription: A coordinated manual-QA team for the Kensa test-management system. A Test Lead plans coverage and reviews; QA Engineers author checklists and test cases grounded in the ISTQB CTFL v4.0.1 syllabus. The base ships kensa + core testing skills plus browser / device / API / automation-result tooling, a cross-platform Stop hook, schema adaptation, and Blueprints node-graph automation; optional bundles (analytics, platform knowledge, brainstorm strategist, source connectors, Playwright automation) layer on top.
